title: TaskFlow — Task Management API and CLI
objective: Build a task management system consisting of an HTTP API and a separate Dart command-line client.
skills: CRUD tasks with IDs, titles, descriptions, statuses, and due dates
Bounded async operations and error handling
Unit/integration tests, API documentation, reproducible dependencies, automated analysis

required_features: CRUD tasks with IDs, titles, descriptions, statuses, and due dates
